market_overview: Across the evidence packet, bullish sentiment dominates in U.S. equities, AI & technology, gold, bitcoin, and the dollar, while interest rates and oil sit in mixed/neutral territory with both bullish and bearish cues. Inflation remains mixed/neutral but leans bearish. The global PSI is neutral (56) with U.S. sentiment bullish (62) and Europe mixed (46). Conflicting coverage appears in most topics, indicating divergent narratives but overall a tilt toward risk‑on assets despite some caution on rates and oil.
